title: homepage search box not link
name: Homepage search box not link
rule: Home page: search box, not a search link. Advanced search is not the default (most people use one or two terms; advanced as default increases mistakes). Tiny/single-page sites may omit search.
pass_when: Home offers a search field (unless the site is tiny/single-page and omits search); default search is simple, not advanced.
fail_when: Home search is only a link to another page, or advanced search is the default.
overview: Homepages offer a search box by default, not a link out to search, unless the site is tiny.
apply_when: Placing search on a site home where people expect an immediate query field.
not_when: Tiny single-page sites that omit search, or advanced search forced as the default.
agent_hint: Put a simple search field on the home page; do not default to advanced search.
description: USWDS home pages provide a search box, not a search link that sends people elsewhere before they can type. Advanced search is not the default because most people use one or two terms and advanced-as-default increases mistakes. Tiny or single-page sites may omit search. A home that only links away to search, or that opens on advanced search, fails the pattern.
